name: HTTP Server
description: Preconfigured net/http server setup for applications that provide a ServeMux and optional middlewares.

files.description: Creates the server, registers optional built-in routes, applies middleware, and starts ListenAndServe.
Defines server host, port, health check, and not-found handler settings.
Provides middleware composition used when the server is run.
Documents expected server usage with http.ServeMux and settings.
